visuals: The snowy peaks of the Ecuadorian Andes mountains under a clear blue sky. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Talk about a country with variety! One minute you're hiking in the Andes Mountains.

visuals: A lush, green tropical rainforest in the Ecuadorian Amazon with a winding river. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Next you're exploring thick Amazon jungles.

visuals: A sunny Pacific coastline in Ecuador with sandy beaches and tropical plants. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Chilling on tropical beaches, or wandering dry forests.

visuals: The majestic Cotopaxi volcano in Ecuador, a snow-capped cone rising from the green Andean mountains. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Did someone say volcanoes? Yes! Cotopaxi, one of the world’s tallest active volcanoes, rises up from the Andes like a massive cone of fire and ice.

visuals: A massive Andean condor with wings spread wide soaring above the mountain peaks of Ecuador. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Soaring over it all is the Andean condor, Ecuador’s mighty national bird; and a symbol of freedom and strength.

visuals: A giant Galápagos tortoise slowly walking through the dry grass of the Galápagos Islands, Ecuador. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Ecuador is home to the giant Galápagos tortoise; slow, wise, and ancient.

visuals: A blue-footed booby bird with bright blue feet standing on a volcanic rock in the Galápagos Islands, Ecuador. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Plus, the silly-looking blue-footed booby that happily struts on the Galápagos Islands.

visuals: The historic Old Town of Quito, Ecuador, with its colonial church towers and colorful buildings nestled in the Andean mountains. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: The capital is Quito! Can you believe it sits high in the mountains, with volcano views AND one of the best-preserved old towns in Latin America?

visuals: The Malecón 2000 riverfront in Guayaquil, Ecuador, with its parks, sculptures, and the wide Guayas River in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Over in Guayaquil, kids can play on a giant iguana-shaped playground near the riverfront.

visuals: A quiet, historic street in Cuenca, Ecuador, with white colonial buildings and a large blue-domed cathedral in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And Cuenca? It’s like walking through a time machine with its neat plazas and churches.

visuals: The historic center of Quito in Ecuador bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Spanish is the main language, but you'll also hear Quechua and other Indigenous tongues all across Ecuador.

visuals: The Malecon 2000 in Guayaquil in Ecuador bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Ecuador has about 18 million people. That’s about half the number of folks in Mexico City and Los Angeles combined!

visuals: A plate of authentic Ecuadorian llapingachos (cheesy potato patties) served with an egg, avocado, and a side salad. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Food? Try llapingachos, yummy potato patties stuffed with cheese. Fried to perfection and served with a side of salad or sausage.

visuals: A traditional festive platter in Ecuador featuring a roasted guinea pig (cuy) served with potatoes and corn. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Want something exciting? In the highlands, people enjoy roasted guinea pig as a special treat.

visuals: A ceramic mug of steaming canelazo (warm cinnamon drink) on a wooden table with the Ecuadorian mountains in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: If you're chilly in the mountains, sip canelazo, a warm cinnamon drink shared at festivals and family parties.

visuals: Cotopaxi National Park in Ecuador bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Speaking of parties, don’t miss Inti Raymi! It’s a traditional sun festival with music, bright costumes, and dancing everywhere.

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Ecuador made it to the Round of 16 in the 2006 World Cup and the fans went wild, jumping and singing across the country.

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Antonio Valencia rocked soccer at Manchester United.

visuals: Ecuadorian cyclist Richard Carapaz celebrating with a gold medal while on his bicycle. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: While Richard Carapaz zoomed to Olympic gold in cycling.

visuals: A pristine Ecuadorian rainforest river with lush greenery and a sign that says 'Derechos de la Naturaleza' (Rights of Nature). No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Ecuador was the first country to give legal rights to nature. That’s like making forests and rivers part of the family!
